This calculus has a dramatic history. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 1940, Wolfgang Doeblin, a young mathematician serving in the French army, mailed the Academy of Sciences a sealed envelope; he died that June, and when it was opened in 2000 it held a version of the same formula. <bookmark mark='b'/> Kiyosi Ito published the stochastic integral in 1944 and the formula in 1951. <bookmark mark='c'/> Black, Scholes and Merton priced options with it in 1973, and it is the working tool for running diffusion models in part twenty-one. <bookmark mark='d'/> Midpoints give Stratonovich's integral, with the ordinary chain rule. Langevin dynamics has drift the score of a target pi, and noise of variance two. <bookmark mark='a'/> Put that into Fokker-Planck. <bookmark mark='b'/> If the density is pi, the drift term gives minus pi double prime, the noise term plus pi double prime, and they cancel: pi is invariant for the continuous-time process, under the usual smoothness and boundary conditions. voiceover_handoff.en_source: The same recipe gives the distributions this series keeps meeting. <bookmark mark='a'/> On the line, fix the mean and the variance, solve numerically, and out comes the bell: it is the most uncertain distribution with a given spread. <bookmark mark='b'/> Fix the average distance from zero instead, and you get Laplace's double exponential. <bookmark mark='c'/> Fix the average energy of a physical system, and you get Boltzmann and Gibbs's distribution, e to the minus energy over temperature, where inverse temperature is the Lagrange multiplier, with Boltzmann's constant set to one. With scores in place of negative energies, that is the softmax at the end of every language model. <bookmark mark='d'/> All of them are one family, the exponential family, and in it the gradient of the log normalizer is the average. So fitting one by maximum likelihood just matches the data's averages.

voiceover_handoff.en_source: This calculus has a dramatic history. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 1940, Wolfgang Doeblin, a young mathematician serving in the French army, mailed the Academy of Sciences a sealed envelope; he died that June, and when it was opened in 2000 it held a version of the same formula. <bookmark mark='b'/> Kiyosi Ito published the stochastic integral in 1944 and the formula in 1951. <bookmark mark='c'/> Black, Scholes and Merton priced options with it in 1973, and it is the working tool for running diffusion models in part twenty-one. <bookmark mark='d'/> Midpoints give Stratonovich's integral, with the ordinary chain rule. The left-point Itô integral uses only information available before each increment. Midpoint limits define a different integral, which also has numerical schemes; one must use the matching drift and interpretation.

voiceover_handoff.zh: 这套微积分有一段戏剧性的历史。<bookmark mark='a'/>1940年，在法国军队服役的年轻数学家沃尔夫冈·德布林，向科学院寄出一个密封信封；他在当年6月去世。2000年信封打开时，里面已有同一公式的一个版本。<bookmark mark='b'/>伊藤清在1944年发表随机积分，1951年发表这个公式。<bookmark mark='c'/>1973年，布莱克、斯科尔斯和默顿用它给期权定价；它也是第21部分运行反向扩散模型的工具。<bookmark mark='d'/>中点极限给出斯特拉托诺维奇积分，保留普通链式法则。左端点的伊藤积分只使用每次增量发生前已有的信息。中点极限定义的是另一种积分，也有数值方案；需要使用与它相匹配的漂移和解释。

voiceover_handoff.en_source: Now the promise from chapter thirteen. Langevin dynamics has drift the score of a target pi, and noise of variance two. <bookmark mark='a'/> Put that into Fokker-Planck. <bookmark mark='b'/> If the density is pi, the drift term gives minus pi double prime, the noise term plus pi double prime, and they cancel: pi is invariant for the continuous-time process, under the usual smoothness and boundary conditions. Reaching it also requires mixing. The finite-step particles of chapter thirteen only approximate this process; unadjusted discretization can shift the equilibrium.

That is why the particles of chapter thirteen settled onto the bumps, and why Langevin dynamics samples anything whose score we know.
voiceover_handoff.zh: 现在兑现第13章的承诺。朗之万动力学的漂移是目标π的分数，噪声方差系数为2。<bookmark mark='a'/>代入福克–普朗克方程。<bookmark mark='b'/>若密度就是π，漂移项给出负π二阶导数，噪声项给出正π二阶导数，恰好抵消。在通常的光滑性和边界条件下，π是连续时间过程的不变分布。要到达它，还需要混合。第13章有限步长的粒子只能近似这个过程；未经校正的离散化可能使平衡分布偏移。

voiceover_handoff.en_source: f"Check it on the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process. <bookmark mark='a'/> Start with data that has two peaks, and let every point drift toward zero and jiggle. <bookmark mark='b'/> Twenty thousand particles and the equation solved on a grid move together: the histogram densities stay within {max(d['hist_err']):.3f} of the exact bin-average density, with both normalized on the shown window from minus four to four. The grid stays within {max(d['fp_err']):.4f} of the exact answer. <bookmark mark='c'/> Wait long enough, and every trace of the data is gone: a plain standard bell. That's what a diffusion model does to its training images."

For the spatially constant noise coefficient used here, the reverse drift has one extra term: <bookmark mark='a'/> the score, the slope of the log of the density at that moment, an arrow saying which way the data gets likelier. <bookmark mark='b'/> It points uphill, toward the data.

voiceover_handoff.en_source: f"Let's take stock. Centered, rescaled sums of independent, identically distributed pieces with positive finite variance approach a bell. In regular models, maximum likelihood is asymptotically efficient: for our Cauchy fit, n times its measured variance is {float(f['mle_nvar'][-1]):.2f} against the bound of two. Bayes's rule is counting, and a prior is a regularizer. Maximum entropy gives the exponential family, softmax included. Hoeffding's bound needed {need['hoeffding']} flips where {need['exact']} sufficed, and held everywhere. Sampling turns uniform numbers into anything; decoding trades diversity for predictability. Chains forget at the rate of their spectral gap in the lazy reversible setting; Monte Carlo errors with finite variance fall like one over root n, and importance weights can collapse in high dimensions. Metropolis corrections preserve the target; fixed-step unadjusted Langevin can bias it. Random motion has its own calculus, whose density obeys Fokker and Planck's law."

voiceover_handoff.zh: 来总结。独立同分布、方差有限且为正的随机量，相加后再中心化和缩放，会趋近钟形分布。若三阶绝对矩有限，贝里–埃塞恩定理把差距限制在某个常数除以根号n以内。对钟形分布做条件化，仍得到钟形分布。在正则模型中，最大似然具有渐近效率：我们的柯西拟合中，n乘以实测方差是{float(f['mle_nvar'][-1]):.2f}，对照下界2。贝叶斯规则就是计数，先验也是正则化。最大熵给出指数族，包括softmax。霍夫丁界要求{need['hoeffding']}次抛硬币，而{need['exact']}次就够了，而且界在这里始终成立。采样把均匀随机数变成各种分布；解码在多样性与可预测性之间取舍。在惰性、可逆的情形下，链的遗忘速度由谱隙决定；方差有限时，蒙特卡洛误差按根号n的倒数下降。高维中的重要性权重可能塌缩。Metropolis校正保留目标分布；固定步长、未经校正的朗之万方案可能使它偏移。随机运动有自己的微积分，密度服从福克–普朗克方程。

voiceover_handoff.zh: 解决办法是先作弊，再纠正。<bookmark mark='a'/>从一个有一半时间落在那里的钟形分布中抽样。<bookmark mark='b'/>然后给每个样本加权：它在真实分布下比在提议分布下可能多少倍。提议分布的刻线图显示记录下来的前400次抽样。<bookmark mark='c'/>两种估计各自都使用全部{n:,}次抽样。对重要性采样来说，{weighted_verdict}单次运行提供的是证据，并不保证一定改善。

voiceover_handoff.en_source: f"Solving that one equation is a tiny training run. Start from the fair die, with lambda zero, and nudge lambda by how far the average is from four and a half. <bookmark mark='a'/> The die tilts toward its high faces, and settles at lambda {lam:.3f}: the chance of each face is about {math.exp(lam):.2f} times the one below it. <bookmark mark='b'/> Its entropy is {H:.4f} nats. Twenty thousand other dice with the same average, made at random: {verdict}."
voiceover_handoff.old_source: f"Solving that one equation is a tiny training run. Start from the fair die, with lambda zero, and nudge lambda by how far the average is from four and a half. <bookmark mark='a'/> The die tilts toward its high faces, and settles at lambda {lam:.3f}: the chance of each face is about {math.exp(lam):.2f} times the one below it. <bookmark mark='b'/> Its entropy is {H:.4f} nats. Twenty thousand other dice with the same average, made at random: {verdict}."
voiceover_handoff.zh: 解这个方程，就是一次小小的训练。从公平骰子、λ为0开始，按均值离4.5还有多远来调整λ。<bookmark mark='a'/>骰子向较大的点数倾斜，最终λ为{lam:.3f}：相邻面的概率满足p(k+1)/p(k)约等于{math.exp(lam):.2f}，也就是较高一面的概率更大。<bookmark mark='b'/>它的熵为{H:.4f}纳特。随机生成的另外两万个骰子，均值都相同：{verdict}。

histogram_metric_contract: hist_err: observed histogram density vs exact mixture CDF bin-average density; both conditioned/normalized on displayed[-4,4]window. fp_err stays grid-to-exact density.
rare_plot_contract: Recorded plain_z[plain_plot_indices] only; indices exactly unique(first400 indices plus all actual z>4 indices). IS rug uses existing first400 recorded is_y. Both numeric estimates use full n draws.
